name: Breitspur
tagline: The versions that should have existed.
description: Breitspur is a design studio for German cars.  We draw the versions the factories never built.

manifesto.lead: Every great car had a sharper version that never made it out of the design studio.  Breitspur draws those cars.
manifesto.body: We start from the factory's own design language and take it one step further than the factory dared.  The goal is a car its original designers would recognize, and wish they had built.

founder.quote: Car companies build these raw, emotional things that never get to see the streets.  I want people to actually get to experience them.
founder.name: Nick DiLoreto
founder.bio: Nick DiLoreto trained as a car designer and started his career at Volvo.  He now leads industrial design for a major consumer hardware brand.  Breitspur is where he draws cars again.

services.title: Commission a concept
services.body: Send photos of your car and tell us what it should have been.  We draw it back as a finished concept: stance, flares, wheels and color, delivered as a gallery plate you can frame or hand to your builder.
details: Notes for your builder on surfacing, wheels and color

services.title: Design consulting
services.body: For shops and makers building kits, wheels or whole cars.  Most aftermarket parts fail in the details: a flare that fights the body line, a radius that catches the light wrong.  We review the surfaces, draw the fixes and help shape the brand around them.
details: Body kit and flare design review

shop.teaser: Wheels, parts and apparel to follow.
shop.intro: Wheels and parts drawn by the studio.  Nothing is on sale yet.  Inquire about a piece and you hear about pricing and build slots first.

categories.title: Wheels
categories.body: Each wheel is drawn for a car in the collection, then machined to order for the car you drive.

categories.title: Carbon parts
categories.body: Splitters, lips, ducktails and roofs in exposed carbon.

categories.title: Body kits
categories.body: Flares and full kits, surfaced to follow the original lines.

process.title: Tell us the car
process.body: Tell us your car, size and finish.  It commits you to nothing.

process.title: Fitment
process.body: We confirm your measurements, brakes and stance with you before a single blank is cut.

process.title: Machined for your car
process.body: Your set is machined, finished, numbered and shipped.

bespoke.label: MADE FOR ONE CAR
bespoke.lead: Machined for one car at a time.
bespoke.body: There is no warehouse and no catalog size.  Each center starts as a forged 7075-T6 blank and is machined to the fitment of the car it is going on.

items.title: Width and offset
items.body: Set to your arches, your tires and the stance you want.

items.title: Bolt pattern and center bore
items.body: Machined to your hub, so the wheel centers itself without adapters or rings.

items.title: Brake clearance
items.body: Checked against your calipers before cutting, including big brake kits.

items.title: Finish
items.body: A short list of center colors, and custom colors on request.

items.title: Numbered
items.body: Every set carries its own serial number.

items.title: Build sheet
items.body: Each set ships with a sheet recording your car, your specification and a drawing of your wheels.

sheet: 15 x 8 in front, 15 x 9 in rear

privacy.intro: Breitspur is a small, independent studio.  We collect as little as we can, we never sell it, and you can ask us to delete it at any time.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Inquiries: if you send the inquiry form, we keep your name, email address, your car and your message.  Netlify, our web host, receives and stores the form for us.

Shop inquiries: if you inquire about a product or sign up for shop updates, we keep your name, email address, your car and the answers you chose, such as size, finish and budget.  Netlify stores these for us too.
Server logs: like any web host, Netlify records basic request data such as IP address, browser type and the pages requested.  We use it only to keep the site running and secure.
We do not run analytics, ad trackers or user accounts, and we set no cookies of our own.

sections.heading: How we use it
body: We use your details to reply to your inquiry and, if we work together, to deliver the project.  If you inquired about a product, we email you about that product only, and use the answers in aggregate to decide what to make.  We send studio news only if you ticked the box for it.  We never sell, rent or trade your details.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: Wherever you live, you can ask what we hold about you, have it corrected, or have it deleted.  Every product email has an unsubscribe link, or write to us through the inquiry form and we will act within 30 days.

sections.heading: Changes
body: If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page.
